intent: Fresh immutable prerelease of the fully validated canonical-only environment_manager build. Supersedes the earlier beta26 tag. Includes Room Environment per-profile temperature/humidity targets and active Automatic/PID/Manual controller methods.
note: Publish the fully green canonical-only room-target/controller activation build under a fresh beta tag
changes: Ship only canonical environment_manager with no legacy-domain migration module, migration config-flow step, legacy runtime constants or legacy storage import
Expose Room Environment targets for Comfort, Home, Away, Sleep and Eco with capability-gated heating, cooling and humidity controls
Keep profile targets editable independently of whether automation is currently Off
Use explicit Away profile targets rather than substituting room hard temperature limits
Selecting Automatic, PID or Manual authorizes that exact native controller to start/stop its supported physical device or native HVAC mode when verified demand requires it
Reselecting an active controller method re-arms a prior software pause without bypassing physical safety checks
Use observed physical OFF age so selecting PID/Automatic does not create an artificial new minimum-OFF interval
Keep minimum ON/OFF, max runtime, availability, windows, ownership, defrost, interlock and acknowledgement protections
Supersede the older v0.6.0b26 prerelease without mutating its tag
